Decisions about heat, frost and flooding are made locally, yet reanalyses and climate models resolve tens of kilometres. Earth system models underpin the evidence that informs net-zero policy, yet their energy demands are rarely considered when judging model quality. Halving CMIP6 error would require 28 times more compute.
